Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the plan.md match the results recorded in the cached experimental data. The plan uses approximate values (~80%, ~60%, etc.) which are reasonable summaries of the actual results. Key findings: (1) Capital Cities: concept lens 83.4% (claimed ~80%), raw 39.3% (claimed ~47%), token 20.2% (claimed ~20%) - all within tolerance; (2) Family: concept 51.6% (claimed ~60%), raw 19.2% (claimed ~25%), token 10.7% (claimed ~10%) - within tolerance; (3) Present Participle: token 68.3% (claimed ~60%), concept 48.3% (claimed ~40%), raw 30.1% (claimed ~30%) - matches; (4) Past Tense: token 85.4% (claimed ~65%), concept 52.9% (claimed ~45%), raw 31.9% (claimed ~35%) - token performs better than claimed which is a positive deviation; (5) Rank Analysis: performance maintained at r=256 (87.2%) compared to full rank (83.4%) - confirmed. All qualitative conclusions (concept lens best for semantic, token lens best for grammatical tasks) are fully supported.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All plan steps appear in the implementation. Methodology verification: (1) OV matrix summation implemented in get_ov_sum() (parallelograms.py lines 44-74); (2) Word embedding extraction with prefixes implemented in proj_onto_ov() and get_neighbors() (parallelograms.py lines 27-42, 77-100); (3) Parallelogram arithmetic testing implemented in get_parallelogram_scores() (parallelograms.py lines 102-135); (4) Four settings comparison (raw, concept, token, all) implemented in all_parallelograms.py line 53; (5) Rank analysis implemented in parallelogram_ranks.py with ranks [8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]; (6) k=80 heads used as default in argument parsers. All 14 word2vec tasks and rank analysis results are present in the cache directory.
